2697template <typename Char, typename Grouping, typename OutputIt,
2698 typename DecimalFP>
2699FMT_CONSTEXPR20 auto write_fixed(OutputIt out, const DecimalFP& f,
2700 int significand_size, Char decimal_point,
2701 const format_specs& specs, sign s,
2702 locale_ref loc = {}) -> OutputIt {
2703 using iterator = reserve_iterator<OutputIt>;
2704
2705 int exp = f.exponent + significand_size;
2706 long long size = significand_size + (s != sign::none ? 1 : 0);
2707 if (f.exponent >= 0) {
2708 // 1234e5 -> 123400000[.0+]
2709 size += f.exponent;
2710 int num_zeros = specs.precision - exp;
2711 abort_fuzzing_if(num_zeros > 5000);
2712 if (specs.alt()) {
2713 ++size;
2714 if (num_zeros <= 0 && specs.type() != presentation_type::fixed)
2715 num_zeros = 0;
2716 if (num_zeros > 0) size += num_zeros;
2717 }
2718 auto grouping = Grouping(loc, specs.localized());
2719 size += grouping.count_separators(exp);
2720 return write_padded<Char, align::right>(
2721 out, specs, static_cast<size_t>(size), [&](iterator it) {
2722 if (s != sign::none) *it++ = detail::getsign<Char>(s);
2723 it = write_significand<Char>(it, f.significand, significand_size,
2724 f.exponent, grouping);
2725 if (!specs.alt()) return it;
2726 *it++ = decimal_point;
2727 return num_zeros > 0 ? detail::fill_n(it, num_zeros, Char('0')) : it;
2728 });
2729 }
2730 if (exp > 0) {
2731 // 1234e-2 -> 12.34[0+]
2732 int num_zeros = specs.alt() ? specs.precision - significand_size : 0;
2733 size += 1 + max_of(num_zeros, 0);
2734 auto grouping = Grouping(loc, specs.localized());
2735 size += grouping.count_separators(exp);
2736 return write_padded<Char, align::right>(
2737 out, specs, static_cast<size_t>(size), [&](iterator it) {
2738 if (s != sign::none) *it++ = detail::getsign<Char>(s);
2739 it = write_significand(it, f.significand, significand_size, exp,
2740 decimal_point, grouping);
2741 return num_zeros > 0 ? detail::fill_n(it, num_zeros, Char('0')) : it;
2742 });
2743 }
2744 // 1234e-6 -> 0.001234
2745 int num_zeros = -exp;
2746 if (significand_size == 0 && specs.precision >= 0 &&
2747 specs.precision < num_zeros) {
2748 num_zeros = specs.precision;
2749 }
2750 bool pointy = num_zeros != 0 || significand_size != 0 || specs.alt();
2751 size += 1 + (pointy ? 1 : 0) + num_zeros;
2752 return write_padded<Char, align::right>(
2753 out, specs, static_cast<size_t>(size), [&](iterator it) {
2754 if (s != sign::none) *it++ = detail::getsign<Char>(s);
2755 *it++ = Char('0');
2756 if (!pointy) return it;
2757 *it++ = decimal_point;
2758 it = detail::fill_n(it, num_zeros, Char('0'));
2759 return write_significand<Char>(it, f.significand, significand_size);
2760 });
2761}
2762
2763template <typename Char, typename Grouping, typename OutputIt,
2764 typename DecimalFP>
2765FMT_CONSTEXPR20 auto do_write_float(OutputIt out, const DecimalFP& f,
2766 const format_specs& specs, sign s,
2767 int exp_upper, locale_ref loc) -> OutputIt {
2768 Char point = specs.localized() ? detail::decimal_point<Char>(loc) : Char('.');
2769 int significand_size = get_significand_size(f);
2770 int exp = f.exponent + significand_size - 1;
2771 if (specs.type() == presentation_type::fixed ||
2772 (specs.type() != presentation_type::exp &&
2773 use_fixed(exp, specs.precision > 0 ? specs.precision : exp_upper))) {
2774 return write_fixed<Char, Grouping>(out, f, significand_size, point, specs,
2775 s, loc);
2776 }
2777
2778 // Write value in the exponential format.
2779 int num_zeros = 0;
2780 long long size = significand_size + (s != sign::none ? 1 : 0);
2781 if (specs.alt()) {
2782 num_zeros = max_of(specs.precision - significand_size, 0);
2783 size += num_zeros;
2784 } else if (significand_size == 1) {
2785 point = Char();
2786 }
2787 size += (point ? 1 : 0) + compute_exp_size(exp);
2788 char exp_char = specs.upper() ? 'E' : 'e';
2789 auto write = [=](reserve_iterator<OutputIt> it) {
2790 if (s != sign::none) *it++ = detail::getsign<Char>(s);
2791 // Insert a decimal point after the first digit and add an exponent.
2792 it = write_significand(it, f.significand, significand_size, 1, point);
2793 if (num_zeros > 0) it = detail::fill_n(it, num_zeros, Char('0'));
2794 *it++ = Char(exp_char);
2795 return write_exponent<Char>(exp, it);
2796 };
2797 size_t usize = static_cast<size_t>(size);
2798 return specs.width > 0
2799 ? write_padded<Char, align::right>(out, specs, usize, write)
2800 : base_iterator(out, write(reserve(out, usize)));
2801}
2802
2803template <typename Char, typename OutputIt, typename DecimalFP>
2804FMT_CONSTEXPR20 auto write_float(OutputIt out, const DecimalFP& f,
2805 const format_specs& specs, sign s,
2806 int exp_upper, locale_ref loc) -> OutputIt {
2807 if (is_constant_evaluated()) {
2808 return do_write_float<Char, fallback_digit_grouping<Char>>(out, f, specs, s,
2809 exp_upper, loc);
2810 } else {
2811 return do_write_float<Char, digit_grouping<Char>>(out, f, specs, s,
2812 exp_upper, loc);
2813 }
2814}

2816template <typename T> constexpr auto isnan(T value) -> bool {
2817 return value != value; // std::isnan doesn't support __float128.
2818}

2820template <typename T, typename Enable = void>
2821struct has_isfinite : std::false_type {};
2822
2823template <typename T>
2824struct has_isfinite<T, enable_if_t<sizeof(std::isfinite(T())) != 0>>
2825 : std::true_type {};
2826
2827template <typename T,
2828 FMT_ENABLE_IF(is_floating_point<T>::value&& has_isfinite<T>::value)>
2829FMT_CONSTEXPR20 auto isfinite(T value) -> bool {
2830 constexpr T inf = T(std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity());
2831 if (is_constant_evaluated())
2832 return !detail::isnan(value) && value < inf && value > -inf;
2833 return std::isfinite(value);
2834}
2835template <typename T, FMT_ENABLE_IF(!has_isfinite<T>::value)>
2836FMT_CONSTEXPR auto isfinite(T value) -> bool {
2837 T inf = T(std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity());
2838 // std::isfinite doesn't support __float128.
2839 return !detail::isnan(value) && value < inf && value > -inf;
2840}

2842template <typename T, FMT_ENABLE_IF(is_floating_point<T>::value)>
2843FMT_INLINE FMT_CONSTEXPR auto signbit(T value) -> bool {
2844 if (is_constant_evaluated()) {
2845#ifdef __cpp_if_constexpr
2846 if constexpr (std::numeric_limits<double>::is_iec559) {
2847 auto bits = detail::bit_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<double>(value));
2848 return (bits >> (num_bits<uint64_t>() - 1)) != 0;
2849 }
2850#endif
2851 }
2852 return std::signbit(static_cast<double>(value));
2853}
2854
2855inline FMT_CONSTEXPR20 void adjust_precision(int& precision, int exp10) {
2856 // Adjust fixed precision by exponent because it is relative to decimal
2857 // point.
2858 if (exp10 > 0 && precision > max_value<int>() - exp10)
2859 FMT_THROW(format_error("number is too big"));
2860 precision += exp10;
2861}
2862
2863class bigint {
2864 private:
2865 // A bigint is a number in the form bigit_[N - 1] ... bigit_[0] * 32^exp_.
2866 using bigit = uint32_t; // A big digit.
2867 using double_bigit = uint64_t;
2868 enum { bigit_bits = num_bits<bigit>() };
2869 enum { bigits_capacity = 32 };
2870 basic_memory_buffer<bigit, bigits_capacity> bigits_;
2871 int exp_;
2872
2873 friend struct formatter<bigint>;
2874
2875 FMT_CONSTEXPR auto get_bigit(int i) const -> bigit {
2876 return i >= exp_ && i < num_bigits() ? bigits_[i - exp_] : 0;
2877 }
2878
2879 FMT_CONSTEXPR void subtract_bigits(int index, bigit other, bigit& borrow) {
2880 auto result = double_bigit(bigits_[index]) - other - borrow;
2881 bigits_[index] = static_cast<bigit>(result);
2882 borrow = static_cast<bigit>(result >> (bigit_bits * 2 - 1));
2883 }
2884
2885 FMT_CONSTEXPR void remove_leading_zeros() {
2886 int num_bigits = static_cast<int>(bigits_.size()) - 1;
2887 while (num_bigits > 0 && bigits_[num_bigits] == 0) --num_bigits;
2888 bigits_.resize(to_unsigned(num_bigits + 1));
2889 }
2890
2891 // Computes *this -= other assuming aligned bigints and *this >= other.
2892 FMT_CONSTEXPR void subtract_aligned(const bigint& other) {
2893 FMT_ASSERT(other.exp_ >= exp_, "unaligned bigints");
2894 FMT_ASSERT(compare(*this, other) >= 0, "");
2895 bigit borrow = 0;
2896 int i = other.exp_ - exp_;
2897 for (size_t j = 0, n = other.bigits_.size(); j != n; ++i, ++j)
2898 subtract_bigits(i, other.bigits_[j], borrow);
2899 if (borrow != 0) subtract_bigits(i, 0, borrow);
2900 FMT_ASSERT(borrow == 0, "");
2901 remove_leading_zeros();
2902 }
2903
2904 FMT_CONSTEXPR void multiply(uint32_t value) {
2905 bigit carry = 0;
2906 const double_bigit wide_value = value;
2907 for (size_t i = 0, n = bigits_.size(); i < n; ++i) {
2908 double_bigit result = bigits_[i] * wide_value + carry;
2909 bigits_[i] = static_cast<bigit>(result);
2910 carry = static_cast<bigit>(result >> bigit_bits);
2911 }
2912 if (carry != 0) bigits_.push_back(carry);
2913 }
2914
2915 template <typename UInt, FMT_ENABLE_IF(std::is_same<UInt, uint64_t>::value ||
2916 std::is_same<UInt, uint128_t>::value)>
2917 FMT_CONSTEXPR void multiply(UInt value) {
2918 using half_uint =
2919 conditional_t<std::is_same<UInt, uint128_t>::value, uint64_t, uint32_t>;
2920 const int shift = num_bits<half_uint>() - bigit_bits;
2921 const UInt lower = static_cast<half_uint>(value);
2922 const UInt upper = value >> num_bits<half_uint>();
2923 UInt carry = 0;
2924 for (size_t i = 0, n = bigits_.size(); i < n; ++i) {
2925 UInt result = lower * bigits_[i] + static_cast<bigit>(carry);
2926 carry = (upper * bigits_[i] << shift) + (result >> bigit_bits) +
2927 (carry >> bigit_bits);
2928 bigits_[i] = static_cast<bigit>(result);
2929 }
2930 while (carry != 0) {
2931 bigits_.push_back(static_cast<bigit>(carry));
2932 carry >>= bigit_bits;
2933 }
2934 }
2935
2936 template <typename UInt, FMT_ENABLE_IF(std::is_same<UInt, uint64_t>::value ||
2937 std::is_same<UInt, uint128_t>::value)>
2938 FMT_CONSTEXPR void assign(UInt n) {
2939 size_t num_bigits = 0;
2940 do {
2941 bigits_[num_bigits++] = static_cast<bigit>(n);
2942 n >>= bigit_bits;
2943 } while (n != 0);
2944 bigits_.resize(num_bigits);
2945 exp_ = 0;
2946 }
2947
2948 public:
2949 FMT_CONSTEXPR bigint() : exp_(0) {}
2950 explicit bigint(uint64_t n) { assign(n); }
2951
2952 bigint(const bigint&) = delete;
2953 void operator=(const bigint&) = delete;
2954
2955 FMT_CONSTEXPR void assign(const bigint& other) {
2956 auto size = other.bigits_.size();
2957 bigits_.resize(size);
2958 auto data = other.bigits_.data();
2959 copy<bigit>(data, data + size, bigits_.data());
2960 exp_ = other.exp_;
2961 }
2962
2963 template <typename Int> FMT_CONSTEXPR void operator=(Int n) {
2964 FMT_ASSERT(n > 0, "");
2965 assign(uint64_or_128_t<Int>(n));
2966 }
2967
2968 FMT_CONSTEXPR auto num_bigits() const -> int {
2969 return static_cast<int>(bigits_.size()) + exp_;
2970 }
2971
2972 FMT_CONSTEXPR auto operator<<=(int shift) -> bigint& {
2973 FMT_ASSERT(shift >= 0, "");
2974 exp_ += shift / bigit_bits;
2975 shift %= bigit_bits;
2976 if (shift == 0) return *this;
2977 bigit carry = 0;
2978 for (size_t i = 0, n = bigits_.size(); i < n; ++i) {
2979 bigit c = bigits_[i] >> (bigit_bits - shift);
2980 bigits_[i] = (bigits_[i] << shift) + carry;
2981 carry = c;
2982 }
2983 if (carry != 0) bigits_.push_back(carry);
2984 return *this;
2985 }
2986
2987 template <typename Int> FMT_CONSTEXPR auto operator*=(Int value) -> bigint& {
2988 FMT_ASSERT(value > 0, "");
2989 multiply(uint32_or_64_or_128_t<Int>(value));
2990 return *this;
2991 }
2992
2993 friend FMT_CONSTEXPR auto compare(const bigint& b1, const bigint& b2) -> int {
2994 int num_bigits1 = b1.num_bigits(), num_bigits2 = b2.num_bigits();
2995 if (num_bigits1 != num_bigits2) return num_bigits1 > num_bigits2 ? 1 : -1;
2996 int i = static_cast<int>(b1.bigits_.size()) - 1;
2997 int j = static_cast<int>(b2.bigits_.size()) - 1;
2998 int end = i - j;
2999 if (end < 0) end = 0;
3000 for (; i >= end; --i, --j) {
3001 bigit b1_bigit = b1.bigits_[i], b2_bigit = b2.bigits_[j];
3002 if (b1_bigit != b2_bigit) return b1_bigit > b2_bigit ? 1 : -1;
3003 }
3004 if (i != j) return i > j ? 1 : -1;
3005 return 0;
3006 }
3007
3008 // Returns compare(lhs1 + lhs2, rhs).
3009 friend FMT_CONSTEXPR auto add_compare(const bigint& lhs1, const bigint& lhs2,
3010 const bigint& rhs) -> int {
3011 int max_lhs_bigits = max_of(lhs1.num_bigits(), lhs2.num_bigits());
3012 int num_rhs_bigits = rhs.num_bigits();
3013 if (max_lhs_bigits + 1 < num_rhs_bigits) return -1;
3014 if (max_lhs_bigits > num_rhs_bigits) return 1;
3015 double_bigit borrow = 0;
3016 int min_exp = min_of(min_of(lhs1.exp_, lhs2.exp_), rhs.exp_);
3017 for (int i = num_rhs_bigits - 1; i >= min_exp; --i) {
3018 double_bigit sum = double_bigit(lhs1.get_bigit(i)) + lhs2.get_bigit(i);
3019 bigit rhs_bigit = rhs.get_bigit(i);
3020 if (sum > rhs_bigit + borrow) return 1;
3021 borrow = rhs_bigit + borrow - sum;
3022 if (borrow > 1) return -1;
3023 borrow <<= bigit_bits;
3024 }
3025 return borrow != 0 ? -1 : 0;
3026 }
3027
3028 // Assigns pow(10, exp) to this bigint.
3029 FMT_CONSTEXPR20 void assign_pow10(int exp) {
3030 FMT_ASSERT(exp >= 0, "");
3031 if (exp == 0) return *this = 1;
3032 int bitmask = 1 << (num_bits<unsigned>() -
3033 countl_zero(static_cast<uint32_t>(exp)) - 1);
3034 // pow(10, exp) = pow(5, exp) * pow(2, exp). First compute pow(5, exp) by
3035 // repeated squaring and multiplication.
3036 *this = 5;
3037 bitmask >>= 1;
3038 while (bitmask != 0) {
3039 square();
3040 if ((exp & bitmask) != 0) *this *= 5;
3041 bitmask >>= 1;
3042 }
3043 *this <<= exp; // Multiply by pow(2, exp) by shifting.
3044 }
3045
3046 FMT_CONSTEXPR20 void square() {
3047 int num_bigits = static_cast<int>(bigits_.size());
3048 int num_result_bigits = 2 * num_bigits;
3049 basic_memory_buffer<bigit, bigits_capacity> n(std::move(bigits_));
3050 bigits_.resize(to_unsigned(num_result_bigits));
3051 auto sum = uint128_t();
3052 for (int bigit_index = 0; bigit_index < num_bigits; ++bigit_index) {
3053 // Compute bigit at position bigit_index of the result by adding
3054 // cross-product terms n[i] * n[j] such that i + j == bigit_index.
3055 for (int i = 0, j = bigit_index; j >= 0; ++i, --j) {
3056 // Most terms are multiplied twice which can be optimized in the future.
3057 sum += double_bigit(n[i]) * n[j];
3058 }
3059 bigits_[bigit_index] = static_cast<bigit>(sum);
3060 sum >>= num_bits<bigit>(); // Compute the carry.
3061 }
3062 // Do the same for the top half.
3063 for (int bigit_index = num_bigits; bigit_index < num_result_bigits;
3064 ++bigit_index) {
3065 for (int j = num_bigits - 1, i = bigit_index - j; i < num_bigits;)
3066 sum += double_bigit(n[i++]) * n[j--];
3067 bigits_[bigit_index] = static_cast<bigit>(sum);
3068 sum >>= num_bits<bigit>();
3069 }
3070 remove_leading_zeros();
3071 exp_ *= 2;
3072 }
3073
3074 // If this bigint has a bigger exponent than other, adds trailing zero to make
3075 // exponents equal. This simplifies some operations such as subtraction.
3076 FMT_CONSTEXPR void align(const bigint& other) {
3077 int exp_difference = exp_ - other.exp_;
3078 if (exp_difference <= 0) return;
3079 int num_bigits = static_cast<int>(bigits_.size());
3080 bigits_.resize(to_unsigned(num_bigits + exp_difference));
3081 for (int i = num_bigits - 1, j = i + exp_difference; i >= 0; --i, --j)
3082 bigits_[j] = bigits_[i];
3083 fill_n(bigits_.data(), to_unsigned(exp_difference), 0U);
3084 exp_ -= exp_difference;
3085 }
3086
3087 // Divides this bignum by divisor, assigning the remainder to this and
3088 // returning the quotient.
3089 FMT_CONSTEXPR auto divmod_assign(const bigint& divisor) -> int {
3090 FMT_ASSERT(this != &divisor, "");
3091 if (compare(*this, divisor) < 0) return 0;
3092 FMT_ASSERT(divisor.bigits_[divisor.bigits_.size() - 1u] != 0, "");
3093 align(divisor);
3094 int quotient = 0;
3095 do {
3096 subtract_aligned(divisor);
3097 ++quotient;
3098 } while (compare(*this, divisor) >= 0);
3099 return quotient;
3100 }
3101};
3102
3103// format_dragon flags.
3104enum dragon {
3105 predecessor_closer = 1,
3106 fixup = 2, // Run fixup to correct exp10 which can be off by one.
3107 fixed = 4,
3108};
3109
3110// Formats a floating-point number using a variation of the Fixed-Precision
3111// Positive Floating-Point Printout ((FPP)^2) algorithm by Steele & White:
3112// https://fmt.dev/papers/p372-steele.pdf.
3113FMT_CONSTEXPR20 inline void format_dragon(basic_fp<uint128_t> value,
3114 unsigned flags, int num_digits,
3115 buffer<char>& buf, int& exp10) {
3116 bigint numerator; // 2 * R in (FPP)^2.
3117 bigint denominator; // 2 * S in (FPP)^2.
3118 // lower and upper are differences between value and corresponding boundaries.
3119 bigint lower; // (M^- in (FPP)^2).
3120 bigint upper_store; // upper's value if different from lower.
3121 bigint* upper = nullptr; // (M^+ in (FPP)^2).
3122 // Shift numerator and denominator by an extra bit or two (if lower boundary
3123 // is closer) to make lower and upper integers. This eliminates multiplication
3124 // by 2 during later computations.
3125 bool is_predecessor_closer = (flags & dragon::predecessor_closer) != 0;
3126 int shift = is_predecessor_closer ? 2 : 1;
3127 if (value.e >= 0) {
3128 numerator = value.f;
3129 numerator <<= value.e + shift;
3130 lower = 1;
3131 lower <<= value.e;
3132 if (is_predecessor_closer) {
3133 upper_store = 1;
3134 upper_store <<= value.e + 1;
3135 upper = &upper_store;
3136 }
3137 denominator.assign_pow10(exp10);
3138 denominator <<= shift;
3139 } else if (exp10 < 0) {
3140 numerator.assign_pow10(-exp10);
3141 lower.assign(numerator);
3142 if (is_predecessor_closer) {
3143 upper_store.assign(numerator);
3144 upper_store <<= 1;
3145 upper = &upper_store;
3146 }
3147 numerator *= value.f;
3148 numerator <<= shift;
3149 denominator = 1;
3150 denominator <<= shift - value.e;
3151 } else {
3152 numerator = value.f;
3153 numerator <<= shift;
3154 denominator.assign_pow10(exp10);
3155 denominator <<= shift - value.e;
3156 lower = 1;
3157 if (is_predecessor_closer) {
3158 upper_store = 1ULL << 1;
3159 upper = &upper_store;
3160 }
3161 }
3162 int even = static_cast<int>((value.f & 1) == 0);
3163 if (!upper) upper = &lower;
3164 bool shortest = num_digits < 0;
3165 if ((flags & dragon::fixup) != 0) {
3166 if (add_compare(numerator, *upper, denominator) + even <= 0) {
3167 --exp10;
3168 numerator *= 10;
3169 if (num_digits < 0) {
3170 lower *= 10;
3171 if (upper != &lower) *upper *= 10;
3172 }
3173 }
3174 if ((flags & dragon::fixed) != 0) adjust_precision(num_digits, exp10 + 1);
3175 }
3176 // Invariant: value == (numerator / denominator) * pow(10, exp10).
3177 if (shortest) {
3178 // Generate the shortest representation.
3179 num_digits = 0;
3180 char* data = buf.data();
3181 for (;;) {
3182 int digit = numerator.divmod_assign(denominator);
3183 bool low = compare(numerator, lower) - even < 0; // numerator <[=] lower.
3184 // numerator + upper >[=] pow10:
3185 bool high = add_compare(numerator, *upper, denominator) + even > 0;
3186 data[num_digits++] = static_cast<char>('0' + digit);
3187 if (low || high) {
3188 if (!low) {
3189 ++data[num_digits - 1];
3190 } else if (high) {
3191 int result = add_compare(numerator, numerator, denominator);
3192 // Round half to even.
3193 if (result > 0 || (result == 0 && (digit % 2) != 0))
3194 ++data[num_digits - 1];
3195 }
3196 buf.try_resize(to_unsigned(num_digits));
3197 exp10 -= num_digits - 1;
3198 return;
3199 }
3200 numerator *= 10;
3201 lower *= 10;
3202 if (upper != &lower) *upper *= 10;
3203 }
3204 }
3205 // Generate the given number of digits.
3206 exp10 -= num_digits - 1;
3207 if (num_digits <= 0) {
3208 auto digit = '0';
3209 if (num_digits == 0) {
3210 denominator *= 10;
3211 digit = add_compare(numerator, numerator, denominator) > 0 ? '1' : '0';
3212 }
3213 buf.push_back(digit);
3214 return;
3215 }
3216 buf.try_resize(to_unsigned(num_digits));
3217 for (int i = 0; i < num_digits - 1; ++i) {
3218 int digit = numerator.divmod_assign(denominator);
3219 buf[i] = static_cast<char>('0' + digit);
3220 numerator *= 10;
3221 }
3222 int digit = numerator.divmod_assign(denominator);
3223 auto result = add_compare(numerator, numerator, denominator);
3224 if (result > 0 || (result == 0 && (digit % 2) != 0)) {
3225 if (digit == 9) {
3226 const auto overflow = '0' + 10;
3227 buf[num_digits - 1] = overflow;
3228 // Propagate the carry.
3229 for (int i = num_digits - 1; i > 0 && buf[i] == overflow; --i) {
3230 buf[i] = '0';
3231 ++buf[i - 1];
3232 }
3233 if (buf[0] == overflow) {
3234 buf[0] = '1';
3235 if ((flags & dragon::fixed) != 0)
3236 buf.push_back('0');
3237 else
3238 ++exp10;
3239 }
3240 return;
3241 }
3242 ++digit;
3243 }
3244 buf[num_digits - 1] = static_cast<char>('0' + digit);
3245}
3246
3247// Formats a floating-point number using the hexfloat format.
3248template <typename Float, FMT_ENABLE_IF(!is_double_double<Float>::value)>
3249FMT_CONSTEXPR20 void format_hexfloat(Float value, format_specs specs,
3250 buffer<char>& buf) {
3251 // float is passed as double to reduce the number of instantiations and to
3252 // simplify implementation.
3253 static_assert(!std::is_same<Float, float>::value, "");
3254
3255 using info = dragonbox::float_info<Float>;
3256
3257 // Assume Float is in the format [sign][exponent][significand].
3258 using carrier_uint = typename info::carrier_uint;
3259
3260 const auto num_float_significand_bits = detail::num_significand_bits<Float>();
3261
3262 basic_fp<carrier_uint> f(value);
3263 f.e += num_float_significand_bits;
3264 if (!has_implicit_bit<Float>()) --f.e;
3265 // Reset the exponent for zero to print it as 0x0p+0.
3266 if (f.f == 0) f.e = 0;
3267
3268 const auto num_fraction_bits =
3269 num_float_significand_bits + (has_implicit_bit<Float>() ? 1 : 0);
3270 const auto num_xdigits = (num_fraction_bits + 3) / 4;
3271
3272 const auto leading_shift = ((num_xdigits - 1) * 4);
3273 const auto leading_mask = carrier_uint(0xF) << leading_shift;
3274 const auto leading_xdigit =
3275 static_cast<uint32_t>((f.f & leading_mask) >> leading_shift);
3276 if (leading_xdigit > 1) f.e -= (32 - countl_zero(leading_xdigit) - 1);
3277
3278 int print_xdigits = num_xdigits - 1;
3279 if (specs.precision >= 0 && print_xdigits > specs.precision) {
3280 const int shift = ((print_xdigits - specs.precision - 1) * 4);
3281 const auto mask = carrier_uint(0xF) << shift;
3282 const auto v = static_cast<uint32_t>((f.f & mask) >> shift);
3283
3284 if (v >= 8) {
3285 const auto inc = carrier_uint(1) << (shift + 4);
3286 f.f += inc;
3287 f.f &= ~(inc - 1);
3288 }
3289
3290 // Check long double overflow.
3291 if (!has_implicit_bit<Float>()) {
3292 const auto implicit_bit = carrier_uint(1) << num_float_significand_bits;
3293 if ((f.f & implicit_bit) == implicit_bit) {
3294 f.f >>= 4;
3295 f.e += 4;
3296 }
3297 }
3298
3299 print_xdigits = specs.precision;
3300 }
3301
3302 char xdigits[num_bits<carrier_uint>() / 4];
3303 detail::fill_n(xdigits, sizeof(xdigits), '0');
3304 format_base2e(4, xdigits, f.f, num_xdigits, specs.upper());
3305
3306 // Remove zero tail.
3307 while (print_xdigits > 0 && xdigits[print_xdigits] == '0') --print_xdigits;
3308
3309 buf.push_back('0');
3310 buf.push_back(specs.upper() ? 'X' : 'x');
3311 buf.push_back(xdigits[0]);
3312 if (specs.alt() || print_xdigits > 0 || print_xdigits < specs.precision)
3313 buf.push_back('.');
3314 buf.append(xdigits + 1, xdigits + 1 + print_xdigits);
3315 for (; print_xdigits < specs.precision; ++print_xdigits) buf.push_back('0');
3316
3317 buf.push_back(specs.upper() ? 'P' : 'p');
3318
3319 uint32_t abs_e;
3320 if (f.e < 0) {
3321 buf.push_back('-');
3322 abs_e = static_cast<uint32_t>(-f.e);
3323 } else {
3324 buf.push_back('+');
3325 abs_e = static_cast<uint32_t>(f.e);
3326 }
3327 format_decimal<char>(appender(buf), abs_e, detail::count_digits(abs_e));
3328}
3329
3330template <typename Float, FMT_ENABLE_IF(is_double_double<Float>::value)>
3331FMT_CONSTEXPR20 void format_hexfloat(Float value, format_specs specs,
3332 buffer<char>& buf) {
3333 format_hexfloat(static_cast<double>(value), specs, buf);
3334}
3335
3336constexpr auto fractional_part_rounding_thresholds(int index) -> uint32_t {
3337 // For checking rounding thresholds.
3338 // The kth entry is chosen to be the smallest integer such that the
3339 // upper 32-bits of 10^(k+1) times it is strictly bigger than 5 * 10^k.
3340 // It is equal to ceil(2^31 + 2^32/10^(k + 1)).
3341 // These are stored in a string literal because we cannot have static arrays
3342 // in constexpr functions and non-static ones are poorly optimized.
3343 return uint32_t(u"\x9999\x828f\x8041\x8006\x8000\x8000\x8000\x8000"[index])
3344 << 16u |
3345 uint32_t(u"\x999a\x5c29\x8938\x8db9\xa7c6\x10c7\x01ae\x002b"[index]);
3346}
3347
3348template <typename Float>
3349FMT_CONSTEXPR20 auto format_float(Float value, int precision,
3350 const format_specs& specs, bool binary32,
3351 buffer<char>& buf) -> int {
3352 // float is passed as double to reduce the number of instantiations.
3353 static_assert(!std::is_same<Float, float>::value, "");
3354 auto converted_value = convert_float(value);
3355
3356 const bool fixed = specs.type() == presentation_type::fixed;
3357 if (value == 0) {
3358 if (precision <= 0 || !fixed) {
3359 buf.push_back('0');
3360 return 0;
3361 }
3362 buf.try_resize(to_unsigned(precision));
3363 fill_n(buf.data(), precision, '0');
3364 return -precision;
3365 }
3366
3367 int exp = 0;
3368 bool use_dragon = true;
3369 unsigned dragon_flags = 0;
3370 if (!is_fast_float<Float>() || is_constant_evaluated()) {
3371 const auto inv_log2_10 = 0.3010299956639812; // 1 / log2(10)
3372 using info = dragonbox::float_info<decltype(converted_value)>;
3373 const auto f = basic_fp<typename info::carrier_uint>(converted_value);
3374 // Compute exp, an approximate power of 10, such that
3375 // 10^(exp - 1) <= value < 10^exp or 10^exp <= value < 10^(exp + 1).
3376 // This is based on log10(value) == log2(value) / log2(10) and approximation
3377 // of log2(value) by e + num_fraction_bits idea from double-conversion.
3378 auto e = (f.e + count_digits<1>(f.f) - 1) * inv_log2_10 - 1e-10;
3379 exp = static_cast<int>(e);
3380 if (e > exp) ++exp; // Compute ceil.
3381 dragon_flags = dragon::fixup;
3382 } else {
3383 // Extract significand bits and exponent bits.
3384 using info = dragonbox::float_info<double>;
3385 auto br = bit_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<double>(value));
3386
3387 const uint64_t significand_mask =
3388 (static_cast<uint64_t>(1) << num_significand_bits<double>()) - 1;
3389 uint64_t significand = (br & significand_mask);
3390 int exponent = static_cast<int>((br & exponent_mask<double>()) >>
3391 num_significand_bits<double>());
3392
3393 if (exponent != 0) { // Check if normal.
3394 exponent -= exponent_bias<double>() + num_significand_bits<double>();
3395 significand |=
3396 (static_cast<uint64_t>(1) << num_significand_bits<double>());
3397 significand <<= 1;
3398 } else {
3399 // Normalize subnormal inputs.
3400 FMT_ASSERT(significand != 0, "zeros should not appear here");
3401 int shift = countl_zero(significand);
3402 FMT_ASSERT(shift >= num_bits<uint64_t>() - num_significand_bits<double>(),
3403 "");
3404 shift -= (num_bits<uint64_t>() - num_significand_bits<double>() - 2);
3405 exponent = (std::numeric_limits<double>::min_exponent -
3406 num_significand_bits<double>()) -
3407 shift;
3408 significand <<= shift;
3409 }
3410
3411 // Compute the first several nonzero decimal significand digits.
3412 // We call the number we get the first segment.
3413 const int k = info::kappa - dragonbox::floor_log10_pow2(exponent);
3414 exp = -k;
3415 const int beta = exponent + dragonbox::floor_log2_pow10(k);
3416 uint64_t first_segment;
3417 bool has_more_segments;
3418 int digits_in_the_first_segment;
3419 {
3420 const auto r = dragonbox::umul192_upper128(
3421 significand << beta, dragonbox::get_cached_power(k));
3422 first_segment = r.high();
3423 has_more_segments = r.low() != 0;
3424
3425 // The first segment can have 18 ~ 19 digits.
3426 if (first_segment >= 1000000000000000000ULL) {
3427 digits_in_the_first_segment = 19;
3428 } else {
3429 // When it is of 18-digits, we align it to 19-digits by adding a bogus
3430 // zero at the end.
3431 digits_in_the_first_segment = 18;
3432 first_segment *= 10;
3433 }
3434 }
3435
3436 // Compute the actual number of decimal digits to print.
3437 if (fixed) adjust_precision(precision, exp + digits_in_the_first_segment);
3438
3439 // Use Dragon4 only when there might be not enough digits in the first
3440 // segment.
3441 if (digits_in_the_first_segment > precision) {
3442 use_dragon = false;
3443
3444 if (precision <= 0) {
3445 exp += digits_in_the_first_segment;
3446
3447 if (precision < 0) {
3448 // Nothing to do, since all we have are just leading zeros.
3449 buf.try_resize(0);
3450 } else {
3451 // We may need to round-up.
3452 buf.try_resize(1);
3453 if ((first_segment | static_cast<uint64_t>(has_more_segments)) >
3454 5000000000000000000ULL) {
3455 buf[0] = '1';
3456 } else {
3457 buf[0] = '0';
3458 }
3459 }
3460 } // precision <= 0
3461 else {
3462 exp += digits_in_the_first_segment - precision;
3463
3464 // When precision > 0, we divide the first segment into three
3465 // subsegments, each with 9, 9, and 0 ~ 1 digits so that each fits
3466 // in 32-bits which usually allows faster calculation than in
3467 // 64-bits. Since some compiler (e.g. MSVC) doesn't know how to optimize
3468 // division-by-constant for large 64-bit divisors, we do it here
3469 // manually. The magic number 7922816251426433760 below is equal to
3470 // ceil(2^(64+32) / 10^10).
3471 const uint32_t first_subsegment = static_cast<uint32_t>(
3472 dragonbox::umul128_upper64(first_segment, 7922816251426433760ULL) >>
3473 32);
3474 const uint64_t second_third_subsegments =
3475 first_segment - first_subsegment * 10000000000ULL;
3476
3477 uint64_t prod;
3478 uint32_t digits;
3479 bool should_round_up;
3480 int number_of_digits_to_print = min_of(precision, 9);
3481
3482 // Print a 9-digits subsegment, either the first or the second.
3483 auto print_subsegment = [&](uint32_t subsegment, char* buffer) {
3484 int number_of_digits_printed = 0;
3485
3486 // If we want to print an odd number of digits from the subsegment,
3487 if ((number_of_digits_to_print & 1) != 0) {
3488 // Convert to 64-bit fixed-point fractional form with 1-digit
3489 // integer part. The magic number 720575941 is a good enough
3490 // approximation of 2^(32 + 24) / 10^8; see
3491 // https://jk-jeon.github.io/posts/2022/12/fixed-precision-formatting/#fixed-length-case
3492 // for details.
3493 prod = ((subsegment * static_cast<uint64_t>(720575941)) >> 24) + 1;
3494 digits = static_cast<uint32_t>(prod >> 32);
3495 *buffer = static_cast<char>('0' + digits);
3496 number_of_digits_printed++;
3497 }
3498 // If we want to print an even number of digits from the
3499 // first_subsegment,
3500 else {
3501 // Convert to 64-bit fixed-point fractional form with 2-digits
3502 // integer part. The magic number 450359963 is a good enough
3503 // approximation of 2^(32 + 20) / 10^7; see
3504 // https://jk-jeon.github.io/posts/2022/12/fixed-precision-formatting/#fixed-length-case
3505 // for details.
3506 prod = ((subsegment * static_cast<uint64_t>(450359963)) >> 20) + 1;
3507 digits = static_cast<uint32_t>(prod >> 32);
3508 write2digits(buffer, digits);
3509 number_of_digits_printed += 2;
3510 }
3511
3512 // Print all digit pairs.
3513 while (number_of_digits_printed < number_of_digits_to_print) {
3514 prod = static_cast<uint32_t>(prod) * static_cast<uint64_t>(100);
3515 digits = static_cast<uint32_t>(prod >> 32);
3516 write2digits(buffer + number_of_digits_printed, digits);
3517 number_of_digits_printed += 2;
3518 }
3519 };
3520
3521 // Print first subsegment.
3522 print_subsegment(first_subsegment, buf.data());
3523
3524 // Perform rounding if the first subsegment is the last subsegment to
3525 // print.
3526 if (precision <= 9) {
3527 // Rounding inside the subsegment.
3528 // We round-up if:
3529 // - either the fractional part is strictly larger than 1/2, or
3530 // - the fractional part is exactly 1/2 and the last digit is odd.
3531 // We rely on the following observations:
3532 // - If fractional_part >= threshold, then the fractional part is
3533 // strictly larger than 1/2.
3534 // - If the MSB of fractional_part is set, then the fractional part
3535 // must be at least 1/2.
3536 // - When the MSB of fractional_part is set, either
3537 // second_third_subsegments being nonzero or has_more_segments
3538 // being true means there are further digits not printed, so the
3539 // fractional part is strictly larger than 1/2.
3540 if (precision < 9) {
3541 uint32_t fractional_part = static_cast<uint32_t>(prod);
3542 should_round_up =
3543 fractional_part >= fractional_part_rounding_thresholds(
3544 8 - number_of_digits_to_print) ||
3545 ((fractional_part >> 31) &
3546 ((digits & 1) | (second_third_subsegments != 0) |
3547 has_more_segments)) != 0;
3548 }
3549 // Rounding at the subsegment boundary.
3550 // In this case, the fractional part is at least 1/2 if and only if
3551 // second_third_subsegments >= 5000000000ULL, and is strictly larger
3552 // than 1/2 if we further have either second_third_subsegments >
3553 // 5000000000ULL or has_more_segments == true.
3554 else {
3555 should_round_up = second_third_subsegments > 5000000000ULL ||
3556 (second_third_subsegments == 5000000000ULL &&
3557 ((digits & 1) != 0 || has_more_segments));
3558 }
3559 }
3560 // Otherwise, print the second subsegment.
3561 else {
3562 // Compilers are not aware of how to leverage the maximum value of
3563 // second_third_subsegments to find out a better magic number which
3564 // allows us to eliminate an additional shift. 1844674407370955162 =
3565 // ceil(2^64/10) < ceil(2^64*(10^9/(10^10 - 1))).
3566 const uint32_t second_subsegment =
3567 static_cast<uint32_t>(dragonbox::umul128_upper64(
3568 second_third_subsegments, 1844674407370955162ULL));
3569 const uint32_t third_subsegment =
3570 static_cast<uint32_t>(second_third_subsegments) -
3571 second_subsegment * 10;
3572
3573 number_of_digits_to_print = precision - 9;
3574 print_subsegment(second_subsegment, buf.data() + 9);
3575
3576 // Rounding inside the subsegment.
3577 if (precision < 18) {
3578 // The condition third_subsegment != 0 implies that the segment was
3579 // of 19 digits, so in this case the third segment should be
3580 // consisting of a genuine digit from the input.
3581 uint32_t fractional_part = static_cast<uint32_t>(prod);
3582 should_round_up =
3583 fractional_part >= fractional_part_rounding_thresholds(
3584 8 - number_of_digits_to_print) ||
3585 ((fractional_part >> 31) &
3586 ((digits & 1) | (third_subsegment != 0) |
3587 has_more_segments)) != 0;
3588 }
3589 // Rounding at the subsegment boundary.
3590 else {
3591 // In this case, the segment must be of 19 digits, thus
3592 // the third subsegment should be consisting of a genuine digit from
3593 // the input.
3594 should_round_up = third_subsegment > 5 ||
3595 (third_subsegment == 5 &&
3596 ((digits & 1) != 0 || has_more_segments));
3597 }
3598 }
3599
3600 // Round-up if necessary.
3601 if (should_round_up) {
3602 ++buf[precision - 1];
3603 for (int i = precision - 1; i > 0 && buf[i] > '9'; --i) {
3604 buf[i] = '0';
3605 ++buf[i - 1];
3606 }
3607 if (buf[0] > '9') {
3608 buf[0] = '1';
3609 if (fixed)
3610 buf[precision++] = '0';
3611 else
3612 ++exp;
3613 }
3614 }
3615 buf.try_resize(to_unsigned(precision));
3616 }
3617 } // if (digits_in_the_first_segment > precision)
3618 else {
3619 // Adjust the exponent for its use in Dragon4.
3620 exp += digits_in_the_first_segment - 1;
3621 }
3622 }
3623 if (use_dragon) {
3624 auto f = basic_fp<uint128_t>();
3625 bool is_predecessor_closer = binary32 ? f.assign(static_cast<float>(value))
3626 : f.assign(converted_value);
3627 if (is_predecessor_closer) dragon_flags |= dragon::predecessor_closer;
3628 if (fixed) dragon_flags |= dragon::fixed;
3629 // Limit precision to the maximum possible number of significant digits in
3630 // an IEEE754 double because we don't need to generate zeros.
3631 const int max_double_digits = 767;
3632 if (precision > max_double_digits) precision = max_double_digits;
3633 format_dragon(f, dragon_flags, precision, buf, exp);
3634 }
3635 if (!fixed && !specs.alt()) {
3636 // Remove trailing zeros.
3637 auto num_digits = buf.size();
3638 while (num_digits > 0 && buf[num_digits - 1] == '0') {
3639 --num_digits;
3640 ++exp;
3641 }
3642 buf.try_resize(num_digits);
3643 }
3644 return exp;
3645}

3647template <typename Char, typename OutputIt, typename T,
3648 FMT_ENABLE_IF(is_floating_point<T>::value)>
3649FMT_CONSTEXPR20 auto write(OutputIt out, T value, format_specs specs,
3650 locale_ref loc = {}) -> OutputIt {
3651 if (specs.localized() && write_loc(out, value, specs, loc)) return out;
3652
3653 // Use signbit because value < 0 is false for NaN.
3654 sign s = detail::signbit(value) ? sign::minus : specs.sign();
3655
3656 if (!detail::isfinite(value))
3657 return write_nonfinite<Char>(out, detail::isnan(value), specs, s);
3658
3659 if (specs.align() == align::numeric && s != sign::none) {
3660 *out++ = detail::getsign<Char>(s);
3661 s = sign::none;
3662 if (specs.width != 0) --specs.width;
3663 }
3664
3665 const int exp_upper = detail::exp_upper<T>();
3666 int precision = specs.precision;
3667 if (precision < 0) {
3668 if (specs.type() != presentation_type::none) {
3669 precision = 6;
3670 } else if (is_fast_float<T>::value && !is_constant_evaluated()) {
3671 // Use Dragonbox for the shortest format.
3672 auto dec = dragonbox::to_decimal(static_cast<fast_float_t<T>>(value));
3673 return write_float<Char>(out, dec, specs, s, exp_upper, loc);
3674 }
3675 }
3676
3677 memory_buffer buffer;
3678 if (specs.type() == presentation_type::hexfloat) {
3679 if (s != sign::none) buffer.push_back(detail::getsign<char>(s));
3680 format_hexfloat(convert_float(value), specs, buffer);
3681 return write_bytes<Char, align::right>(out, {buffer.data(), buffer.size()},
3682 specs);
3683 }
3684
3685 if (specs.type() == presentation_type::exp) {
3686 if (precision == max_value<int>())
3687 report_error("number is too big");
3688 else
3689 ++precision;
3690 if (specs.precision != 0) specs.set_alt();
3691 } else if (specs.type() == presentation_type::fixed) {
3692 if (specs.precision != 0) specs.set_alt();
3693 } else if (precision == 0) {
3694 precision = 1;
3695 }
3696 int exp = format_float(convert_float(value), precision, specs,
3697 std::is_same<T, float>(), buffer);
3698
3699 specs.precision = precision;
3700 auto f = big_decimal_fp{buffer.data(), static_cast<int>(buffer.size()), exp};
3701 return write_float<Char>(out, f, specs, s, exp_upper, loc);
3702}
3703
3704template <typename Char, typename OutputIt, typename T,
3705 FMT_ENABLE_IF(is_fast_float<T>::value)>
3706FMT_CONSTEXPR20 auto write(OutputIt out, T value) -> OutputIt {
3707 if (is_constant_evaluated()) return write<Char>(out, value, format_specs());
3708
3709 auto s = detail::signbit(value) ? sign::minus : sign::none;
3710 auto mask = exponent_mask<fast_float_t<T>>();
3711 if ((bit_cast<decltype(mask)>(value) & mask) == mask)
3712 return write_nonfinite<Char>(out, std::isnan(value), {}, s);
3713
3714 auto dec = dragonbox::to_decimal(static_cast<fast_float_t<T>>(value));
3715 auto significand = dec.significand;
3716 int significand_size = count_digits(significand);
3717 int exponent = dec.exponent + significand_size - 1;
3718 if (use_fixed(exponent, detail::exp_upper<T>())) {
3719 return write_fixed<Char, fallback_digit_grouping<Char>>(
3720 out, dec, significand_size, Char('.'), {}, s);
3721 }
3722
3723 // Write value in the exponential format.
3724 const char* prefix = "e+";
3725 int abs_exponent = exponent;
3726 if (exponent < 0) {
3727 abs_exponent = -exponent;
3728 prefix = "e-";
3729 }
3730 auto has_decimal_point = significand_size != 1;
3731 size_t size = std::is_pointer<OutputIt>::value
3732 ? 0u
3733 : to_unsigned((s != sign::none ? 1 : 0) + significand_size +
3734 (has_decimal_point ? 1 : 0) +
3735 (abs_exponent >= 100 ? 5 : 4));
3736 if (auto ptr = to_pointer<Char>(out, size)) {
3737 if (s != sign::none) *ptr++ = Char('-');
3738 if (has_decimal_point) {
3739 auto begin = ptr;
3740 ptr = format_decimal<Char>(ptr, significand, significand_size + 1);
3741 *begin = begin[1];
3742 begin[1] = '.';
3743 } else {
3744 *ptr++ = static_cast<Char>('0' + significand);
3745 }
3746 if (std::is_same<Char, char>::value) {
3747 memcpy(ptr, prefix, 2);
3748 ptr += 2;
3749 } else {
3750 *ptr++ = static_cast<Char>(prefix[0]);
3751 *ptr++ = static_cast<Char>(prefix[1]);
3752 }
3753 if (abs_exponent >= 100) {
3754 *ptr++ = static_cast<Char>('0' + abs_exponent / 100);
3755 abs_exponent %= 100;
3756 }
3757 write2digits(ptr, static_cast<unsigned>(abs_exponent));
3758 return select<std::is_pointer<OutputIt>::value>(ptr + 2, out);
3759 }
3760 auto it = reserve(out, size);
3761 if (s != sign::none) *it++ = Char('-');
3762 // Insert a decimal point after the first digit and add an exponent.
3763 it = write_significand(it, significand, significand_size, 1,
3764 has_decimal_point ? Char('.') : Char());
3765 *it++ = Char('e');
3766 it = write_exponent<Char>(exponent, it);
3767 return base_iterator(out, it);
3768}

3853// An argument visitor that formats the argument and writes it via the output
3854// iterator. It's a class and not a generic lambda for compatibility with C++11.
3855template <typename Char> struct default_arg_formatter {
3856 using context = buffered_context<Char>;
3857
3858 basic_appender<Char> out;
3859
3860 void operator()(monostate) { report_error("argument not found"); }
3861
3862 template <typename T, FMT_ENABLE_IF(is_builtin<T>::value)>
3863 void operator()(T value) {
3864 write<Char>(out, value);
3865 }
3866
3867 template <typename T, FMT_ENABLE_IF(!is_builtin<T>::value)>
3868 void operator()(T) {
3869 FMT_ASSERT(false, "");
3870 }
3871
3872 void operator()(typename basic_format_arg<context>::handle h) {
3873 // Use a null locale since the default format must be unlocalized.
3874 auto parse_ctx = parse_context<Char>({});
3875 auto format_ctx = context(out, {}, {});
3876 h.format(parse_ctx, format_ctx);
3877 }
3878};

3895 void operator()(typename basic_format_arg<buffered_context<Char>>::handle) {
3896 // User-defined types are handled separately because they require access
3897 // to the parse context.

3901struct dynamic_spec_getter {
3902 template <typename T, FMT_ENABLE_IF(is_integer<T>::value)>
3903 FMT_CONSTEXPR auto operator()(T value) -> ullong {
3904 return is_negative(value) ? ~0ull : static_cast<ullong>(value);
3905 }
3906
3907 template <typename T, FMT_ENABLE_IF(!is_integer<T>::value)>
3908 FMT_CONSTEXPR auto operator()(T) -> ullong {
3909 report_error("width/precision is not integer");
3910 return 0;
3911 }
3912};
3913
3914template <typename Context>
3915FMT_CONSTEXPR void handle_dynamic_spec(
3916 arg_id_kind kind, int& value,
3917 const arg_ref<typename Context::char_type>& ref, Context& ctx) {
3918 if (kind == arg_id_kind::none) return;
3919 auto arg =
3920 kind == arg_id_kind::index ? ctx.arg(ref.index) : ctx.arg(ref.name);
3921 if (!arg) report_error("argument not found");
3922 ullong result = arg.visit(dynamic_spec_getter());
3923 if (result > to_unsigned(max_value<int>()))
3924 report_error("width/precision is out of range");
3925 value = static_cast<int>(result);
3926}

3963template <typename Char = char> struct format_handler {
3964 parse_context<Char> parse_ctx;
3965 buffered_context<Char> ctx;
3966
3967 void on_text(const Char* begin, const Char* end) {
3968 copy_noinline<Char>(begin, end, ctx.out());
3969 }
3970
3971 FMT_CONSTEXPR auto on_arg_id() -> int { return parse_ctx.next_arg_id(); }
3972 FMT_CONSTEXPR auto on_arg_id(int id) -> int {
3973 parse_ctx.check_arg_id(id);
3974 return id;
3975 }
3976 FMT_CONSTEXPR auto on_arg_id(basic_string_view<Char> id) -> int {
3977 parse_ctx.check_arg_id(id);
3978 int arg_id = ctx.arg_id(id);
3979 if (arg_id < 0) report_error("argument not found");
3980 return arg_id;
3981 }
3982
3983 FMT_INLINE void on_replacement_field(int id, const Char*) {
3984 ctx.arg(id).visit(default_arg_formatter<Char>{ctx.out()});
3985 }
3986
3987 auto on_format_specs(int id, const Char* begin, const Char* end)
3988 -> const Char* {
3989 auto arg = ctx.arg(id);
3990 if (!arg) report_error("argument not found");
3991 // Not using a visitor for custom types gives better codegen.
3992 if (arg.format_custom(begin, parse_ctx, ctx)) return parse_ctx.begin();
3993
3994 auto specs = dynamic_format_specs<Char>();
3995 begin = parse_format_specs(begin, end, specs, parse_ctx, arg.type());
3996 if (specs.dynamic()) {
3997 handle_dynamic_spec(specs.dynamic_width(), specs.width, specs.width_ref,
3998 ctx);
3999 handle_dynamic_spec(specs.dynamic_precision(), specs.precision,
4000 specs.precision_ref, ctx);
4001 }
4002
4003 arg.visit(arg_formatter<Char>{ctx.out(), specs, ctx.locale()});
4004 return begin;
4005 }
4006
4007 FMT_NORETURN void on_error(const char* message) { report_error(message); }
4008};

4018template <typename T, typename Char, type TYPE>
4019template <typename FormatContext>
4020FMT_CONSTEXPR auto native_formatter<T, Char, TYPE>::format(
4021 const T& val, FormatContext& ctx) const -> decltype(ctx.out()) {
4022 if (!specs_.dynamic())
4023 return write<Char>(ctx.out(), val, specs_, ctx.locale());
4024 auto specs = format_specs(specs_);
4025 handle_dynamic_spec(specs.dynamic_width(), specs.width, specs_.width_ref,
4026 ctx);
4027 handle_dynamic_spec(specs.dynamic_precision(), specs.precision,
4028 specs_.precision_ref, ctx);
4029 return write<Char>(ctx.out(), val, specs, ctx.locale());
4030}

4035// A generic formatting context with custom output iterator and character
4036// (code unit) support. Char is the format string code unit type which can be
4037// different from OutputIt::value_type.
4038template <typename OutputIt, typename Char> class generic_context {
4039 private:
4040 OutputIt out_;
4041 basic_format_args<generic_context> args_;
4042 locale_ref loc_;
4043
4044 public:
4045 using char_type = Char;
4046 using iterator = OutputIt;
4047 enum { builtin_types = FMT_BUILTIN_TYPES };
4048
4049 constexpr generic_context(OutputIt out,
4050 basic_format_args<generic_context> args,
4051 locale_ref loc = {})
4052 : out_(out), args_(args), loc_(loc) {}
4053 generic_context(generic_context&&) = default;
4054 generic_context(const generic_context&) = delete;
4055 void operator=(const generic_context&) = delete;
4056
4057 constexpr auto arg(int id) const -> basic_format_arg<generic_context> {
4058 return args_.get(id);
4059 }
4060 auto arg(basic_string_view<Char> name) const
4061 -> basic_format_arg<generic_context> {
4062 return args_.get(name);
4063 }
4064 constexpr auto arg_id(basic_string_view<Char> name) const -> int {
4065 return args_.get_id(name);
4066 }
4067
4068 constexpr auto out() const -> iterator { return out_; }
4069
4070 FMT_CONSTEXPR void advance_to(iterator it) {
4071 if (!detail::is_back_insert_iterator<iterator>()) out_ = it;
4072 }
4073
4074 constexpr auto locale() const -> locale_ref { return loc_; }
4075};

4095template <typename Locale> class format_facet : public Locale::facet {
4096 private:
4097 std::string separator_;
4098 std::string grouping_;
4099 std::string decimal_point_;
4100
4101 protected:
4102 virtual auto do_put(appender out, loc_value val,
4103 const format_specs& specs) const -> bool;

4106 static FMT_API typename Locale::id id;

4108 explicit format_facet(Locale& loc);

4110 std::string decimal_point = ".")

4112 grouping_(std::move(grouping)),
4113 decimal_point_(std::move(decimal_point)) {}
4114
4115 auto put(appender out, loc_value val, const format_specs& specs) const
4116 -> bool {
4117 return do_put(out, val, specs);

4284template <typename T, typename Char = char> struct nested_formatter {
4285 private:
4286 basic_specs specs_;
4287 int width_;
4288 formatter<T, Char> formatter_;
4289
4290 public:
4291 constexpr nested_formatter() : width_(0) {}
4292
4293 FMT_CONSTEXPR auto parse(parse_context<Char>& ctx) -> const Char* {
4294 auto it = ctx.begin(), end = ctx.end();
4295 if (it == end) return it;
4296 auto specs = format_specs();
4297 it = detail::parse_align(it, end, specs);
4298 specs_ = specs;
4299 Char c = *it;
4300 auto width_ref = detail::arg_ref<Char>();
4301 if ((c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '{') {
4302 it = detail::parse_width(it, end, specs, width_ref, ctx);
4303 width_ = specs.width;
4304 }
4305 ctx.advance_to(it);
4306 return formatter_.parse(ctx);
4307 }
4308
4309 template <typename FormatContext, typename F>
4310 auto write_padded(FormatContext& ctx, F write) const -> decltype(ctx.out()) {
4311 if (width_ == 0) return write(ctx.out());
4312 auto buf = basic_memory_buffer<Char>();
4313 write(basic_appender<Char>(buf));
4314 auto specs = format_specs();
4315 specs.width = width_;
4316 specs.copy_fill_from(specs_);
4317 specs.set_align(specs_.align());
4318 return detail::write<Char>(
4319 ctx.out(), basic_string_view<Char>(buf.data(), buf.size()), specs);
4320 }
4321
4322 auto nested(const T& value) const -> nested_view<T, Char> {
4323 return nested_view<T, Char>{&formatter_, &value};
4324 }
4325};

4357class format_int {
4358 private:
4359 // Buffer should be large enough to hold all digits (digits10 + 1),
4360 // a sign and a null character.
4361 enum { buffer_size = std::numeric_limits<ullong>::digits10 + 3 };
4362 mutable char buffer_[buffer_size];
4363 char* str_;
4364
4365 template <typename UInt>
4366 FMT_CONSTEXPR20 auto format_unsigned(UInt value) -> char* {
4367 auto n = static_cast<detail::uint32_or_64_or_128_t<UInt>>(value);
4368 return detail::do_format_decimal(buffer_, n, buffer_size - 1);
4369 }
4370
4371 template <typename Int>
4372 FMT_CONSTEXPR20 auto format_signed(Int value) -> char* {
4373 auto abs_value = static_cast<detail::uint32_or_64_or_128_t<Int>>(value);
4374 bool negative = value < 0;
4375 if (negative) abs_value = 0 - abs_value;
4376 auto begin = format_unsigned(abs_value);
4377 if (negative) *--begin = '-';
4378 return begin;
4379 }
4380
4381 public:
4382 FMT_CONSTEXPR20 explicit format_int(int value) : str_(format_signed(value)) {}
4383 FMT_CONSTEXPR20 explicit format_int(long value)
4384 : str_(format_signed(value)) {}
4385 FMT_CONSTEXPR20 explicit format_int(long long value)
4386 : str_(format_signed(value)) {}
4387 FMT_CONSTEXPR20 explicit format_int(unsigned value)
4388 : str_(format_unsigned(value)) {}
4389 FMT_CONSTEXPR20 explicit format_int(unsigned long value)
4390 : str_(format_unsigned(value)) {}
4391 FMT_CONSTEXPR20 explicit format_int(ullong value)
4392 : str_(format_unsigned(value)) {}
4393
4395 FMT_CONSTEXPR20 auto size() const -> size_t {
4396 return detail::to_unsigned(buffer_ - str_ + buffer_size - 1);
4397 }
4398
4401 FMT_CONSTEXPR20 auto data() const -> const char* { return str_; }
4402
4405 FMT_CONSTEXPR20 auto c_str() const -> const char* {
4406 buffer_[buffer_size - 1] = '\0';
4407 return str_;
4408 }
4409
4411 inline auto str() const -> std::string { return {str_, size()}; }
4412};

4416 /* Use the hidden visibility as a workaround for a GCC bug (#1973). */ \
4417 /* Use a macro-like name to avoid shadowing warnings. */ \
4418 struct FMT_VISIBILITY("hidden") FMT_COMPILE_STRING : base { \
4419 using char_type = fmt::remove_cvref_t<decltype(s[0])>; \
4420 constexpr explicit operator fmt::basic_string_view<char_type>() const { \
4421 return fmt::detail::compile_string_to_view<char_type>(s); \

4423 }; \

4425 fmt::basic_string_view<typename FMT_COMPILE_STRING::char_type>; \
4426 fmt::detail::ignore_unused(FMT_STRING_VIEW(FMT_COMPILE_STRING())); \
4427 return FMT_COMPILE_STRING(); \
4428 }()
